en.headline: Amber Rainstorm Warning and Thunderstorm Warning in force this evening
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory issued the Amber Rainstorm Warning at 6:45 p.m. and extended the Thunderstorm Warning, with violent gusts recorded and further heavy rain expected overnight and tomorrow morning.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory issued an Amber Rainstorm Warning Signal at 6:45 p.m. on Wednesday, indicating that heavy rain exceeding 30 millimetres per hour had fallen or was expected to fall generally over Hong Kong and was likely to continue.

The Observatory said flooding could occur in some low-lying and poorly drained areas. It advised people likely to be affected to take precautions and to stay away from watercourses because of the risk of flash floods.

The Thunderstorm Warning, first issued at 5:20 a.m., was extended into the evening. Gusts of around 80 kilometres per hour were recorded at Tai O at about 6:35 p.m., and the Observatory warned that violent gusts reaching 90 kilometres per hour or above could affect the territory. An active southerly airstream was bringing showers and squally thunderstorms, with rain expected to remain occasionally heavy overnight and tomorrow morning before easing later on Thursday.

zh.headline: 黃色暴雨及雷暴警告生效 大澳錄得時速80公里陣風
zh.dek: 天文台下午6時45分發出黃色暴雨警告，雷暴警告延長，預料今晚及明早雨勢有時頗大，並可能有猛烈陣風。
body: 香港天文台於星期三下午6時45分發出黃色暴雨警告信號，表示香港廣泛地區已錄得或預料會有每小時雨量超過30毫米的大雨，且雨勢可能持續。
天文台表示，一些低窪地帶及排水欠佳的地區會出現水淹，可能受影響的市民應採取預防措施；大雨亦可能引致山洪暴發，市民應遠離河道。
清晨5時20分發出的雷暴警告已延長，下午6時35分左右大澳錄得每小時約80公里的陣風，天文台預料可能有時速90公里或以上的猛烈陣風。受活躍偏南氣流影響，今晚及明早雨勢有時頗大及有狂風雷暴，稍後驟雨逐漸減少。
